Photovoltaic supply chain A dynamic, flexible and sustainable service network made up of local suppliers aligned to our values. ![Trabajador de SOltec trabajando durante el proceso de cadena de suministro en Solhub](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==) ## Responsible supply chain practices Aware that having a diversified supply chain guaranteeing supply and service to customers is paramount, we have built a **dynamic, flexible and sustainable network of local suppliers** which allows us to be better prepared to face any global market disruption. Our procurement policies aim to **build a solid foundation of certified suppliers with the aim to meet customer demands** and expectations through efficient and transparent management, all with the intent to continuously identify and mitigate inherent social and environmental risks throughout the supply chain. ## Management model Supply chain management **is coordinated by Procurement**, a department considered cross-functional and strategic in the management of projects developed by Soltec. This department has four clearly differentiated functional areas which are aligned to Soltec’s strategy: Procurement It forecasts the supply needs of future projects. It facilitates negotiation planning based on required production capacity and location. Sourcing It searches for suppliers capable of expanding our production capacity, reducing prices and opening new markets. Manufacture It controls manufacture linked to issued purchase orders so as to ensure timely delivery. Purchases It negotiates price and deadline conditions with suppliers, so as to issue purchase orders which meet project milestones. ## The principles of the Procurement department The functions performed by the Procurement department, from the sourcing phase to supplier accreditation and selection for purchase operations, are carried out in line with **key principles and sustainability criteria** defined in the Procurement Policy, approved in 2020. These principles are based on the company’s quality certificates and on the **United Nations Global Compact principles.** [Purchasing policy](https://soltec.com/uploads/2023/07/Politica-de-Compras-Soltec.pdf) ## A dynamic, flexible and local supply chain Over the last few years, we built a supply chain management model which allows us, on the one hand, to **guarantee the supply of solar trackers to customers** while mitigating the effects of market disruptions and, on the other hand, to **offer new support services to photovoltaic plants** through our extensive network of local contractors who are in a better position to adapt and respond to major industry disruptions. This management model required us to expand and diversify the number of suppliers of products, materials and services, with the aim to provide customers with quick supply alternatives, regardless of their geographical location. To this end, we have made the supplier accreditation process more flexible and streamlined, **building a large global supplier network which helps us place orders quickly and efficiently.** [![Trabajador de Soltec trabajando durante la cadena de suministro](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==)](https://soltec.com/uploads/2023/07/cadena-de-suministro-4-150x150.jpg) [![Trabajador de Soltec trabajando durante la cadena de suministro](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==)](https://soltec.com/uploads/2023/07/cadena-de-suministro-3-150x150.jpg) Solar tracker manufacture and supply We work with a large number of end-product manufacturers and steel mills worldwide so as to supply all customers regardless of their market situation or location, as well as to reinforce our commitment to sustainable and local development. The company aims to have at least several viable alternatives which can supply end products or materials quickly. Support services for photovoltaic plants In 2022, we strengthened our market position by offering a variety of services which make us much more than just a mere tracker supplier. Due to the characteristics of this type of projects, procurement management is often done with contractors at a national level. This diversification of local suppliers does not only seek to guarantee project support services, but also to respond quicker to local procurement requirements in different countries. ## In-House process optimization through the Lean methodology In **November 2021**, we rolled out a project using the Lean methodology, with the aim to enhance **tracker supply project management**. Through the definition of responsibilities, the aim is to **optimize supply chain management processes** and **remove tasks which do not add value**, with the ultimate goal of promoting a cultural change focused on the improvement of project management. Management Improved definition of roles and responsibilities within supply chain management. Coordination Greater engagement of teams, improving coordination, reducing inefficiencies and avoiding task duplications. Optimization Optimized project communication and control, clearly establishing priorities, anticipating problems and making the most of opportunities. Results Improved project results and clear quality, cost and deadline targets. ## Certificates We have internationally recognized certifications that guarantee our supply chain, guaranteeing responsible and high quality products.
